How far an arm may stretch past its length to reach a hand goal, as a fraction of the arm length.
How far a leg may stretch past its length to reach a foot goal, as a fraction of the leg length.
Fraction of the upper arm twist shown on the upper arm. The forearm and hand turn with all of it.
Fraction of the forearm twist shown on the forearm. The hand turns with all of it.
Fraction of the upper leg twist shown on the upper leg. The lower leg and foot turn with all of it.
